post.text:
The singularity, one day at a time ⚡

The last 24 hours in AI, in 3 minutes:
- Trump renames AI 'super intelligence'
- $2.4B Genesis Mission AI pledges
- Gemini agent gets its own email
- OpenAI: ~$50B revenue, not ~$68B
- Samsung: record ~$80B quarterly profit

Feel the SI.
post.alt: A 3-minute, fast-cut motion-graphics showreel of the last 24 hours of AI news (9 Oct 2026): Trump's 'super intelligence' push and the $2.4B Genesis Mission pledges, Google's Gemini agent, OpenAI's revenue reset and the AI-stock slide, record TSMC and Samsung results, a hurricane forecast shaped by AI, an AI-aided bank hack, Waymo's $5B loan and more, with captions and sources.

stories.title: Trump calls anyone who still says 'AI' instead of 'super intelligence' 'THE ENEMY!'
stories.summary: On Thursday 8 Oct, Trump pressed on with his push to rename AI 'super intelligence', calling anyone who refuses to use his preferred term 'THE ENEMY!', Forbes reports. Politico notes it came a week after he signed an executive order renaming AI 'super intelligence'.

stories.title: Genesis Mission summit: 11 firms pledge $2.4B in AI credits for federal science
stories.summary: Trump announced $2.4B in pledges from 11 firms, mostly AI credits and tools for federal agencies' AI-driven science: Nvidia $1B, AMD $500M, OpenAI $200M, Anthropic $150M and Google $150M, with AMP and Emerald AI about $100M each.

predictions.note: Eleven firms pledged $2.4B, mostly AI credits and tools, for federal agencies' AI-driven science, a push to use AI in research.

stories.title: Google Cloud's Gemini agent takes goals, works for days and gets its own email
stories.summary: Google Cloud introduced the Gemini agent, a single AI agent for work that takes goals instead of questions. Google says it works in the background for days and can join a team as a staffer with its own account and email; it runs on both Gemini and Claude.

predictions.note: Google's new Gemini agent takes goals and, Google says, works in the background for days, a commercial multi-day agent.
The Gemini agent can join a team as a staffer with its own email, putting people in the role of coordinating AI coworkers.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission: infrastructure defense and a free open-source scanner
stories.summary: Anthropic's Cyber Mission starts with a critical infrastructure defense program and a free OSS Scanner giving open-source projects periodic vulnerability scans from its strongest models. Partners include Deloitte, PwC and CrowdStrike, according to Axios.

stories.title: Anthropic's usage policy now bans 'sustained and needless' abuse of Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy bans 'sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior' toward Claude, as well as election interference, weapons software and surveillance, The Verge reports. Ending the conversation stays the 'primary enforcement mechanism'.

predictions.note: A frontier lab's usage policy now bans needless cruelty toward its model, a step for AI welfare in corporate rules.

stories.title: Agent startup Manus raises over $500M after Meta's deal was unwound
stories.summary: Manus parent Butterfly Effect raised more than $500M in a round led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, its first funding since Beijing forced Meta to unwind its roughly $2B acquisition. The valuation was not disclosed.

stories.title: OpenAI tells investors its annualized revenue is about $50B, not the $68B widely reported
stories.summary: OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue was about $50B at the end of September, lower than widely reported, according to the FT and CNBC. A source told CNBC the $68B figure included partners' gross revenue.

stories.title: AI stocks slide after OpenAI's revenue reset; Nvidia-backed Firmus shelves its IPO
stories.summary: On Thursday CoreWeave fell about 8%, Oracle about 6% and Nvidia 3%, per CNBC. Reuters reports that Firmus, a data-centre operator backed by Nvidia, shelved its planned IPO, citing market volatility and weak demand.

stories.title: TSMC posts record Q3 revenue of NT$1.49 trillion, up 50% on AI demand
stories.summary: TSMC reported record third-quarter revenue of NT$1.49 trillion (about US$46.7B), up 50% year on year on surging AI demand.

stories.title: Samsung estimates record Q3 operating profit of about $80B, up almost ninefold
stories.summary: Samsung estimated its third-quarter operating profit jumped almost ninefold (+783%) to a record 107.4 trillion won, or $80.2B, as AI memory demand booms. The figure is a preliminary estimate.

stories.title: Hurricane forecasters shape Isaias track to closely match a Google DeepMind AI model
stories.summary: Meteorologists at the National Hurricane Center in Miami shaped their predictions for Hurricane Isaias to closely match an AI hurricane model from Google DeepMind, CNN reports.

predictions.note: The National Hurricane Center shaped its Isaias forecast to closely match an AI model, AI advice carrying real weight in a public agency.

stories.title: Isomorphic Labs reportedly seeks funding at a valuation of at least $40B
stories.summary: Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs, the AlphaFold-derived drug-discovery spin-off from Google DeepMind, is in early talks to raise new funding at a valuation of at least $40B, according to Bloomberg.

predictions.note: Alphabet's AI drug-discovery spin-off reportedly seeks a valuation of at least $40B, a big bet on AI-designed medicines.

stories.title: CrowdStrike: an AI-aided hacker hit Korean banks, then asked Claude where to sell the data
stories.summary: CrowdStrike says a suspected attacker's servers held Claude Code session histories and configs for ARTEX, a Chinese open-source agentic pentesting tool, and the user asked Claude where to sell Korean breach data. Shinhan (~25,000 customers), KB Kookmin, Hana and BNK were hit.

stories.title: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers warn of a 'chilling effect'
stories.summary: In an open letter, Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita Balesni deny mishandling information and say their terminations 'are chilling the open culture OpenAI has prized'. OpenAI cites a 'pattern of misconduct' and denies retaliation.

stories.title: Waymo closes a $5B term loan, its first debt financing, to expand its robotaxis
stories.summary: Waymo closed a $5B term loan, its first debt financing, to expand its robotaxi service, Reuters reports. Lenders include Blackstone and PIMCO, according to TechCrunch.

predictions.note: Waymo took on $5B of debt to expand its robotaxi service, scaling robots doing a real-world physical job.

stories.title: TSMC taps GlobalFoundries to make AI-chip interposers in the US in a $2B deal
stories.summary: GlobalFoundries signed a $2B manufacturing deal to make TSMC's silicon interposers for CoWoS packaging in the US, with a production ramp-up planned for 2028.

predictions.note: A $2B deal to make AI-chip packaging parts in the US is capital flowing into chip manufacturing capacity.

stories.title: California tells robot-fighting league Rek: no fights involving humans without approval
stories.summary: California's State Athletic Commission called Rek's 18 Sep human-vs-robot fight 'unsanctioned' and told it to stop holding, promoting or advertising any boxing or MMA contest 'involving any human' in the state without approval. The robot was piloted by a human via remote VR.

stories.title: AWS open-sources a Physical AI Toolchain for training and deploying robots
stories.summary: Amazon Web Services launched an open-source Physical AI Toolchain to help robotics companies train, simulate, deploy and improve AI-powered robots.

stories.title: Trump gives National Medals to Musk, Huang, Su, Brin, Nadella and Dell
stories.summary: At the White House science awards, Trump hailed Elon Musk as a 'modern day Thomas Edison'. Musk, Huang, Su and Brin received the Medal of Science; headlines also name Nadella and Dell.

stories.title: USA Today Co. and 18 affiliated papers sue OpenAI for more than $250M
stories.summary: USA Today Co. and 18 affiliated newspapers sued OpenAI in New York federal court, seeking over $250M and the destruction of models they allege were trained on their articles.

Science: the National Hurricane Center shaped its f orecast to closely match a Google DeepMind AI model.
